mainEntity.name: What role does content quality play in AI SEO compared to keyword density?

acceptedAnswer.text: In AI SEO, content quality plays a far more significant role than simple keyword density. Modern AI algorithms prioritize content that is comprehensive, authoritative, relevant, and truly answers a user's intent, rather than just containing a specific number of keywords. While keywords are still important for topic identification, AI can understand semantic relationships and context, meaning over-stuffing keywords can actually harm your rankings. The focus has shifted to creating valuable, well-researched content that demonstrates expertise and provides a superior user experience, which AI rewards.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI SEO prioritizes content quality, authority, and user intent over simple keyword density; AI understands semantic relationships, making valuable content more impactful.
